finding.statement: The Supervisor-8.73 successor on main removed timestamp and candidate narration from stable Forge replay identity but reintroduced delta_id into both execution replay identity and measured-evidence identity. Because delta_id names the candidate/evaluation envelope rather than a measured execution, re-keying only delta_id could mint a second Distillery packet and accepted-dataset-token increment for the same measured execution.
finding.donor_evidence: Closed unmerged PR #1687 explicitly excluded delta_id from replay identity and included a delta_id-only duplicate regression; the current 8.73 main test no longer covered that case.

hypothesis: Excluding envelope-only delta_id from stable execution identity and measured-evidence identity will collapse delta-id-only replay to DUPLICATE while preserving distinct executions through worker/source/evaluation/targets/execution-admission/provider/model/role/metric bindings.
counterhypothesis: delta_id is a stable measured-execution identifier and should distinguish independently admissible executions.
counterhypothesis_disposition: REJECTED_AT_CURRENT_SOURCE_AND_STEERING_CONTRACT_LEVEL: current Supervisor 8.73 specifies stable execution identity from source, worker, target blobs, provider/model/role, execution admission and measured metric identity, while the original replay-hardening donor explicitly classifies delta_id as envelope identity.

remove delta_id from legacy replay-collision discriminator so ambiguous pre-v1 overlap fails closed even after envelope re-key
add explicit delta_id-only replay regression and re-keyed legacy-row regression
